    Composition of string coefficient-component maps #

    Composition is matrix multiplication in the position bases. This file records that formula at the coefficient level and specializes it to the component-indicator basis. It is the algebraic interface for the remaining proper-overlap nilpotence argument.

      Composition of two graph-component basis maps is the convolution of their zero-one component indicators over intermediate word positions.
